hero.lede: Apply, track your EMIs and pay by UPI from your phone. Field officers stay with you at every step, in your language.
hero.trust: Registered NBFC-MFI. Your data stays in India.

strip.s1s: We email you a code. No phone number needed.
strip.s3s: Use the app in your language

cust.title: Your loan, in your pocket
cust.sub: Every screen below is from the LH Microfinance app. Tap a step to see it on the phone.
cust.c1p: Open the app and pick your language. No forms on the first screen.
cust.c2p: Sign in or create an account with just your name, email and a password.
cust.c3p: Next payment, EMIs paid, what is left to repay, and one tap to record a payment.

staff.title: Built for the field and the branch
staff.sub: Field officers plan visits and collections. Branch staff see each customer's device health and, with consent, where it last checked in.
staff.s1p: Money to collect, visits planned, and offline collections that sync later.
staff.s2p: Every registered phone with a fresh, stale or withdrawn status.
staff.s3p: Phone model, last check-in, SIM state and the actions staff can take.
staff.s4p: Where each consenting customer's phone last checked in, on a live map.
staff.s5p: Battery, network, location accuracy and sync history for one phone.

map.title: Every device, anywhere in India
map.sub: A real map you can pan and zoom anywhere in the country. Search a place or show your own location. Pins are sample devices; real customer data stays in the signed-in staff app.
map.search: Search a city, area or PIN code
map.consentNote: Location is shown only for customers who opted in. Staff must request access, and every view is logged.
map.meDenied: Location permission was denied in your browser.
map.notFound: No place found for that search.
map.tiles: Google Maps can't load in this preview.

how.title: From application to last EMI
how.c1p: Install the app, choose your language and sign in with your email.
how.c2p: Pick a loan, add your details and photos of your documents.
how.c3p: After a short field visit, the money is sent to your bank account.
how.c4p: Get reminders before each due date and pay in a few taps.
how.s1p: Help a customer apply on their own phone or yours.
how.s2p: Visit, check documents and record notes, even offline.
how.s3p: Maker-checker approvals with a full audit trail.
how.s4p: Track collections and device check-ins on the map.

trust.title: Fair lending, done carefully
trust.t1p: Location is optional. Customers can say no, and can withdraw consent at any time.
trust.t2p: Staff access to a device is recorded: who looked, when and why.
trust.t3p: A standard install can't lock, wipe or block the customer's phone.
trust.t4p: Secure sign-in without sharing a phone number.
trust.t5p: Field collections are saved on the phone and sync when back online.
trust.t6p: Hosted in India by a registered NBFC-MFI.

dl.title: Get LH Microfinance on your phone
dl.sub: Download the Android app directly. It's free and takes about a minute to install.
dl.i2: When asked, allow installs from your browser.
dl.i3: Open LH Microfinance and choose your language.
dl.qr: Scan with your phone camera to download
